title: The $L^p$ Neumann problem for the Stokes system in nonsmooth domains
summary: We study the $L^p$ Neumann problem for the Stokes system on bounded Lipschitz domains in $\mathbb R^n$ with $n\ge 2$. Our main contribution is to introduce a nonlinear gradient quantity -- namely, the linear gradient weighted by a suitable power of the pair $(\nabla u,φ)$ -- in place of the standard linear gradient used in previous work by Geng and Shen (2025). This new approach allows us to establish a global second-order estimate, which in turn yields an improved reverse Hölder inequality and extends the known range of solvability for convex domains, particularly improving the upper bound…
